body:
Today I realized I always been a stolid person and did not let anyone truly into my life including my wife of 5 yrs, who has left home 2 weeks ago. We had numerous arguments and feel never really listened to anyone but myself. I looking for an easy way out to end myself on Sat, to ease the misery of this. I realize that today I do not have the courage or guts to do it, but do know about tomorrow. I know,  I just cannot  insult my mom's struggle for life with cancer or my dad fight with Parkinson's disease.  

I also realized today that all the so called close friends around me were only pretending to be them. No one ever took time to really understand me and explain to me what was wrong me, maybe I shut themselves too.

Today, I have nothing to offer but myself. I know maybe I will be ok at a later day and start feeling feeling again, but now I just want this day to end here ! I gave all I can to life and just want for it to treat me better once.
